description:
Why does everything cost more? Foot the Bill follows the money behind your electric bill, rent, groceries and paycheck, and shows who really pays, with real data and animated 3D charts.

Each episode takes one big story (AI data centers, the housing market, layoffs, inflation, the national debt) and traces it all the way to your wallet. Every number comes from public sources such as the EIA, the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the Census Bureau and the Federal Reserve, and the sources are listed under every video.

New explainers every week. Subscribe if you want to know where your money really goes.

Episodes are researched and fact-checked against public data. Narration uses an AI voice. Nothing on this channel is financial advice.
